question: What claim about transmission is made by stating that the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: The teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
It is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover to the beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved one, the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover.
